experiment_meta.phase: Phase 5F — Controlled XGBoost Experiment & Model Comparison

model_decision.operational_recommendation: Maintain frozen Logistic Regression (lr-v5f3-standardized) as operational advisory model. Retain XGBoost as an offline experimental challenger benchmark.
rationale: XGBoost demonstrates high discriminative performance on the controlled test split (Macro F1 0.941 vs LR 0.902), correctly classifying 20/20 flare events and 4/4 wildfire events.

However, on the cross-geographic holdout partition (evaluating unseen wildfire biomes in the Rockies/Plains), XGBoost experiences a non-trivial performance drop comparable to other tree models, reflecting sensitivity to localized biome radiative distributions.
The test wildfire partition is 99.4% dominated by a single incident (Cedar Creek Fire, 829/834 obs), meaning observation-level scores reflect single-event memorization risk.
Linear Logistic Regression provides fully transparent, auditable feature weights with monotone interpretability for human investigators without opaque tree splits.
Per Phase 6.1 and 6.2 governance, production architecture remains fixed on frozen LR.
